info.name: Moneyone FinPro
info.description:
MoneyOne (Fintech Products and Solutions India Pvt. Ltd.) operates as a Technology Service Provider (TSP). One of its offerings, FinPro, is a platform designed to facilitate the onboarding of Financial Information Users (FIUs) into the Account Aggregator (AA) ecosystem.

Moneyone Technology Service Provider (TSP) platform allows an FIU (Financial Information User) to support integration with all authorized Account Aggregators in the ecosystem in a dynamic, yet trusted manner by providing a ready implementation of the latest FIU API specifications published by ReBIT.

**Features of FinPro**

- FinPro enable FIs, NBFCs, Insurance companies and all qualified regulated entities, to participate in the AA ecosystem.
    
- It enables all participating organizations to receive data as per RBI regulation and be compliant with it.
    
- Provides innovations to make consumer journeys seamless, data usage convenient and compliant.
    

---

## Prerequisites

- Begin by setting up the FinPro UAT/Production for your FIU with our assistance. Please contact us at [support@moneyone.in ](https://mailto:support@moneyone.in) for any help.
    
- You will receive access to the **FinPro** **Admin Portal**.
    
- Before proceeding with API testing, please set up the below configuration in FinPro portal:
    
    - **Consent template**
        
    - **Webhook notification**
        
- Our team will provide you with the **API Keys** required to test the APIs. You can also regenerate them in the admin portal.
    
    - **Organization ID**
        
    - **Client ID**
        
    - **Client secret**
        
    - **App Identifier**
        

---

## **Integration Steps**

- FIU raises a consent request for the customer using one of the available Consent Request APIs.
    
- FinPro generates a Web Redirection URL against the consent request.
    
- FIU navigates the customer to the Web Redirection URL to complete the AA consent journey.
    
- The customer reviews the consent request details and either approves or rejects the consent.
    
- Once the customer has acted on the consent, FinPro sends a webhook notification to the FIU with the consent status.
    
- While configuring the consent template, FIU can set the Data Request Mode as either automatic or manual.
    
- In automatic mode, FinPro automatically fetches the data from AA once the consent is approved.
    
- In manual mode, FIU must trigger a data fetch request using the FI Request API after the consent is approved.
    
- Once the requested data is successfully fetched from AA and ready, FinPro sends a webhook notification to FIU indicating data availability.
    
- FIU fetches the customer’s financial data using the Data Management APIs
    

---

## FinPro Portal Setup

To get started with the FinPro integration the following would be required:

- Acquire login credentials from Moneyone team for the FinPro Portal.
    
- Login to FinPro Portal using username and password
    

#### Consent Template Configuration

1. Navigate to Consent Templates from the side navigation menu in the FinPro portal.
    
2. A table will be displayed listing all the existing Consent Templates.
    
3. If there are no Consent Templates available, you will need to create at least one.
    
4. To create a new Consent Template, click on the "Create Consent Template" button visible on the screen.
    
5. Fill in the details in the respective sections:
    
    1. Template details such as Purpose code, Template name, etc.
        
    2. Consent request details such as Consent validity, consent types, FI types, etc.
        
    3. Data request details such as Fetch type, frequency, etc.
        
    4. Data filters (optional) based on transaction type or amount.
        

#### Webhook Notification Configuration

Webhook is a feature to receive notifications for subscribed events.

- Notifications are triggered on completion of the subscribed event.
    
- The notification to a subscribed event is sent to a webhook URL setup by the FIU.
    
- The notification is sent as a plain string message.
    
- When setting up the webhook, you will be asked to specify a secret. Using this secret, you can validate that the webhook is from Moneyone.
    

For. e.g., if a webhook has been setup for consent approval event then notification would be sent once a user approves consent.

#### **Setting up of Webhook**

1. Navigate to Admin → Webhooks from the side navigation menu in the FinPro portal.
    
2. A table will be displayed listing all the existing Webhooks configured.
    
3. To set up a new webhook, fill in the required details and save it.
    
    1. Event categories such as Consent-related, Data-related, etc.
        
    2. Enter the Webhook URL along with Secret and App Identifier.
        
    3. Each event category has a list of events that the FIU can subscribe to. Select the required events.
        

#### List of Events

| Event | Triggered When |
| --- | --- |
| Consent Approve | Triggered by FinPro to FIU when a user approves a raised consent |
| Consent Reject | Triggered by FinPro to FIU when a user rejects a raised consent |
| Consent Revoke | Triggered by FinPro to FIU when a user revokes a consent |
| Consent Expiry | Triggered by FinPro to FIU when an active consent expires |
| Consent Pause | Triggered by FinPro to FIU when an active consent has been paused by customer |
| Consent Resume | Triggered by FinPro to FIU when a paused consent has been resumed by customer |
| Data Request | Triggered by FinPro to FIU when a data request is placed by FinPro to AA |
| Data Ready | Triggered by FinPro to FIU when the requested data is ready to be shared |
| Data Push | Triggered by FinPro to FIU to push the financial data to FIU endpoint |
| Data Denied | Triggered by FinPro to FIU when the requested data has been denied by FIPs |
| Session Expired | Triggered by FinPro to FIU when the session between FIU and Onemoney expires |
| Session Failed | Triggered by FinPro to FIU when FIP fails to provide data or delivery fails |
| Event Status Updated | Triggered by FIU to AA whenever any updates were made in the AA |

#### Mechanism to verify the notification

- Generate a signature by using the secret entered when setting up webhooks using the below code.
    
- Generate a X-Webhook-Signature using [https://www.jokecamp.com/blog/examples-of-creating-base64-hashes-using-hmac-sha256-in-different-languages/](https://www.jokecamp.com/blog/examples-of-creating-base64-hashes-using-hmac-sha256-in-different-languages/)
    
- Secret is what FIU has configured in the FinPro portal. After secret is generated, the generated signature and the X-Webhook-Signature from request header matches, the data is said to be coming from the correct source.
    
- Use the below code to verify that the notification is coming from Moneyone server and to generate signature
    

```
requests.get(url, headers={‘X-Webhook-Signature’: })

 ```

"timestamp": "<timestamp>",
"consentHandle": "<consent handle value>",
"eventType": "<event type>",
"eventStatus": "<event status>",
"consentId": "<consent id>",

## API Sequence

<u><b>Consent Flow</b></u>

- **Consent Request API :** To raise consent request. Use only one of the provided APIs as per the requirement. Please refer to the Consent Management section.
    
- **Web Redirection Encryption API (Optional) :** To generate an encrypted url of the account aggregator for a particular consent.
    
- **Web Redirection Decryption API (Optional) :** To decrypt the encrypted consent response from AA.
    
- **Consent List API (Optional) :** To get the list of consent artefact. Alternatively, FIU can setup Consent level webhook (in admin portal) to receive notification whenever consent status gets updated.
    

<u><b>Data Flow</b></u>

- **FI Request API (Conditional) :** If fetch mode for the particular consent is set as Manual then this API should be called to initiate a data request.  
    Note (i): For Auto Manual mode, the first data request will be automatically initiated by FinPro. But from the second data request, FIU has to call this API.
    
- **FI Request Status API (Conditional & Optional) :** To check the status of the data request made. Alternatively, FIU can setup Data Ready webhook (in admin portal) to receive notification once the data is fetched from AA and is ready for consumption.
    
- There are **multiple FI Data APIs** that the FIU can use as per the requirement. Please refer to the Datam Management section.
    

<u><b>Additional APIs</b></u>

- **Revoke Consent API :** The FIU can revoke any active consent using this API.
    
- **Check Profile API :** To check if the user has an existing profile with the corresponding AA (i.e., VUA exists or not).

request.description:
This API provides the list of consents and the details associated with the passed Party Identifier Type (e.g. Mobile Number).

Note:

- Use this API to fetch all consents associated to a mobile number.
    

#### Request Parameters

| Parameter | Type | **Mandatory vs Optional** | **Validation** | **Description** | **Supported Values** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| mobileNumber | string | mandatory | Exactly 10 digits (0-9) | Mobile number of the customer for which consent list is to be fetched |  |
| productID | string | optional | Alphanumeric identifiers only | Consent template ID for which consent list to be fetched. |  |
| accountID | string | optional | Alphanumeric + underscore, hyphen, dot only | Customer Reference Number for which consent list to be fetched. |  |
| status | array | optional |  | Status of the consent | ACTIVE, PAUSED, REVOKED, EXPIRED, PENDING, REJECTED |

#### Response Parameters

| **Parameter** | **Type** | **Mandatory vs Optional** | **Description** | **Supported Values** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| status | string | optional | Status of the response. |  |
| ver | string | Optional | Version of the API. |  |
| timestamp | string | optional | The timestamp of the transaction. |  |
| data.consentID | string | optional | Unique consent ID. A consent ID is generated only for an approved consent. Pending and Rejected consent will not have consent ID. Consent ID is used to fetch data. |  |
| data.consentHandle | string | mandatory | Unique consent handle of the consent request raised. |  |
| data.status | string | mandatory | Status of the consent. | PENDING, ACTIVE, REVOKED, PAUSED, REJECTED, EXPIRED, FAILED |
| data.productID | string | mandatory | Consent template ID used to create this consent. |  |
| data.accountID | string | mandatory | Customer Reference Number passed during consent creation. |  |
| data.aaId | string | mandatory | AA ID |  |
| data.vua | string | mandatory | VUA is a unique identifier for the customer provided by the Account Aggregator (AA). |  |
| data.consentCreationDate | string($date-time) | mandatory | Start date and time of consent validity. |  |
| data.consentExpiry | string($date-time) | mandatory | End data and time of consent validity. |  |
| data.accounts | array | optional | List of accounts for which consent has been approved by the user. |  |
| data.accounts.fipName | string | mandatory | FIP Name where the account belongs. |  |
| data.accounts.fipID | string | mandatory | FIP ID corresponding to the FIP name. It is a unique ID. |  |
| data.accounts.accountType | string | mandatory | Type of account. |  |
| data.accounts.linkReferenceNumber | string | mandatory | A unique UUID to identify the account. It is provided by the FIP post a successful account linking in the AA profile. |  |
| data.accounts.maskedAccount | string | mandatory | Masked Account number as provided by FIP. |  |
| data.accounts.fiType | string | mandatory | FI Type of the account. | DEPOSIT, TERM_DEPOSIT, TERM-DEPOSIT, RECURRING_DEPOSIT, SIP, CP, GOVT_SECURITIES, EQUITIES, BONDS, DEBENTURES, MUTUAL_FUNDS, ETF, IDR, CIS, AIF, INSURANCE_POLICIES, NPS, INVIT, REIT, GSTR1_3B, LIFE_INSURANCE, GENERAL_INSURANCE, OTHER |

#### Error Response Format

When an error occurs, the API returns a JSON object with the following structure:

| Sr. No. | Field | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `ver` | String (Optional) |
| 2 | `timestamp` | String (Optional) |
| 3 | `errorCode` | String (Optional) |
| 4 | `errorMsg` | String (Optional) |
| 5 | `status` | String (Optional) |

#### Error Code Catalogue

| # | Error Code | Error Message | Payload (Request Body) | Tested | Violated Rule |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | InvalidRequest | \[ mobileNumber is required \] | `{}` | Y | mobileNumber is mandatory field |
| 2 | InvalidRequest | \[ mobileNumber must contain value \] \[ mobileNumber must be valid 10 digit \] | `{"mobileNumber": ""}` | Y | mobileNumber cannot be empty string |
| 3 | InvalidRequest | \[ mobileNumber must be valid 10 digit \] | `{"mobileNumber": "123"}` | Y | mobileNumber must be exactly 10 digits |
| 4 | InvalidRequest | \[ mobileNumber must be valid 10 digit \] | `{"mobileNumber": "12345678901"}` | Y | mobileNumber must be exactly 10 digits (not 11) |
| 5 | InvalidRequest | \[ mobileNumber must be valid 10 digit \] | `{"mobileNumber": "abcd123456"}` | Y | mobileNumber must contain only digits 0-9 |
| 6 | InvalidRequest | \[ productID must contain value \] \[ productID value can have only A to Z, a to z, 0 to 9, _ , - and . characters \] | `{"mobileNumber": "9497448320", "productID": ""}` | Y | productID cannot be empty string when provided |
| 7 | InvalidRequest | \[ productID value can have only A to Z, a to z, 0 to 9, _ , - and . characters \] | `{"mobileNumber": "9597448320", "productID": "prod@123"}` | Y | productID can only have alphanumeric, underscore, hyphen, dot |
| 8 | InvalidRequest | \[ productID value can have only A to Z, a to z, 0 to 9, _ , - and . characters \] | `{"mobileNumber": "9597448320", "productID": "prod#id"}` | Y | productID cannot contain special chars like # |
| 9 | InvalidRequest | \[ productID value can have only A to Z, a to z, 0 to 9, _ , - and . characters \] | `{"mobileNumber": "9597448320", "productID": "prod id"}` | Y | productID cannot contain spaces |
| 10 | InvalidRequest | \[ accountID must contain value \] \[ accountID value can have only A to Z, a to z, 0 to 9, _ , - and . characters \] | `{"mobileNumber": "9597448320", "accountID": ""}` | Y | accountID cannot be empty string when provided |
| 11 | InvalidRequest | \[ accountID value can have only A to Z, a to z, 0 to 9, _ , - and . characters \] | `{"mobileNumber": "9597448320", "accountID": "acc@123"}` | Y | accountID can only have alphanumeric, underscore, hyphen, dot |
| 12 | InvalidRequest | \[ accountID value can have only A to Z, a to z, 0 to 9, _ , - and . characters \] | `{"mobileNumber": "9597448320", "accountID": "acc#id"}` | Y | accountID cannot contain special chars like # |
| 13 | InvalidRequest | \[ accountID value can have only A to Z, a to z, 0 to 9, _ , - and . characters \] | `{"mobileNumber": "9597448320", "accountID": "acc id"}` | Y | accountID cannot contain spaces |
| 14 | InvalidRequest | \[ status > 0 must be one of \[ACTIVE, PAUSED, REVOKED, EXPIRED, PENDING, REJECTED\] \] | `{"mobileNumber": "9597448320", "status": ["INVALID_STATUS"]}` | Y | status array must only contain valid values |
| 15 | InvalidRequest | \[ status > 1 must be one of \[ACTIVE, PAUSED, REVOKED, EXPIRED, PENDING, REJECTED\] \] | `{"mobileNumber": "9597448320", "status": ["ACTIVE", "INVALID"]}` | Y | All values in status array must be valid |
| 16 | InvalidRequest | \[ mobileNumber must be valid 10 digit \] \[ productID value can have only A to Z, a to z, 0 to 9, _ , - and . characters \] | `{"mobileNumber": "123", "productID": "prod@123"}` | Y | Multiple validation rules violated |
| 17 | InvalidRequest | entered an invalid ProductID. | `{"mobileNumber": "9497448320", "productID": "NONEXISTENT_PRODUCT"}` | Y | productID must exist in products table |
| 18 | InternalError | Something went wrong with the request payload. | `{"mobileNumber": "9497448320"}` | Setup Required (Not tested) | Unexpected exceptions in code |

**Note:** Finpro not validating serviceable/ non-serviceable mobile numbers. | | | productID | string | mandatory | Alphanumeric identifiers only | Consent template ID for which consent list to be fetched. | | | accountID | string | mandatory | Alphanumeric + underscore, hyphen, dot only | Customer Reference Number for which consent list to be fetched. | | #### Response Parameters | **Parameter** | **Type** | **Mandatory vs Optional** | **Description** | **Supported Values** | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | status | string | optional | Status of the response. | | | ver | string | Optional | Version of the API. | | | data.consentID | string | optional | Unique consent ID. A consent ID is generated only for an approved consent. Pending and Rejected consent will not have consent ID. Consent ID is used to fetch data. | | | data.consentHandle | string | mandatory | Unique consent handle of the consent request raised. | | | data.status | string | mandatory | Status of the consent. | PENDING, ACTIVE, REVOKED, PAUSED, REJECTED, EXPIRED, FAILED | | data.productID | string | mandatory | Consent template ID used to create this consent. | | | data.accountID | string | mandatory | Customer Reference Number passed during consent creation. | | | data.aaId | string | mandatory | AA ID | | | data.vua | string | mandatory | VUA is a unique identifier for the customer provided by the Account Aggregator (AA). | | | data.consentCreationDate | string($date-time) | mandatory | Start date and time of consent validity. | | | data.consentExpiry | string($date-time) | mandatory | End data and time of consent validity. | | | data.accounts | array | optional | List of accounts for which consent has been approved by the user. | | | data.accounts.fipName | string | mandatory | FIP Name where the account belongs. | | | data.accounts.fipID | string | mandatory | FIP ID corresponding to the FIP name. request.description:
# Consent List with Unique Accounts This API endpoint retrieves a list of consents associated with unique Financial Information (FI) accounts for a given customer. It is designed to help organizations fetch and manage consent records efficiently, ensuring that each consent corresponds to a unique account. --- ## Purpose Use this API to obtain a list of consents that are linked to unique FI accounts for a specific customer. This is particularly useful for scenarios where you need to display or process consents without duplication of account information. --- ## Usage Notes - The API supports pagination through optional query parameters (`limit` and `offset`). - Only consents with unique account lists are returned. - The API can filter consents by status (e.g., ACTIVE, PENDING, REJECTED). - Pending and Rejected consents will not have a consent ID. - Data will be received only if consent status is active. Other cases data won't  be available. --- ## HTTP Request **POST** `{{Base_URL}}/v1/accounts/getconsentslist` --- ## Query Parameters (Optional) | Parameter | Type | Description | Example | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | limit | integer | Maximum number of records per page | limit=2 | | offset | integer | Page number (starting from 1) | offset=1 | --- ## Request Body Parameters | Parameter | Type | Mandatory | Description | Supported Values | Validation | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | mobileNumber | string | Yes | Mobile number of the customer for which consent list is fetched | | Exactly 10 digits (0-9) | | productID | string | No | Consent template ID for which consent list is fetched | | Alphanumeric identifiers only | | accountID | string | No | Customer Reference Number for which consent list is fetched | | Alphanumeric + underscore, hyphen, dot only | | status | array | No | Status of the consent.
Data will be received only if consent status is active. Other cases data won't be available. | ACTIVE, PAUSED, REVOKED, EXPIRED, PENDING, REJECTED | | **Example Request Body:** ``` json { "mobileNumber": "", "productID": "", "status": ["REJECTED", "PENDING"] } ``` --- ## Response Parameters | Parameter | Type | Mandatory | Description | Supported Values | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | status | string | No | Status of the response | | | ver | string | No | Version of the API | | | pageDetails.totalRecords | integer | Yes\* | Total number of records (if pagination is used) | | | pageDetails.currentPageNumber | string | Yes\* | The offset value passed (if pagination is used) | | | pageDetails.totalPages | string | Yes\* | Total number of pages (if pagination is used) | | | data.consentID | string | No | Unique consent ID (only for approved consents) | | | data.consentHandle | string | Yes | Unique consent handle of the consent request raised | | | data.status | string | Yes | Status of the consent | ACTIVE, PAUSED, REVOKED, EXPIRED, PENDING, REJECTED | | timestamp | string | optional | The timestamp of the transaction. | | _Parameters marked with 'Yes_' are mandatory only if pagination query parameters are provided in the request. --- #### Error Response Format When an error occurs, the API returns a JSON object with the following structure: | Sr. No. | Field | Type | | --- | --- | --- | | 1 | `ver` | String (Optional) | | 2 | `timestamp` | String (Optional) | | 3 | `errorCode` | String (Optional) | | 4 | `errorMsg` | String (Optional) | | 5 | `status` | String (Optional) | #### Error Code Catalogue | # request.description:
This API decrypts the encrypted response URL received by the FIU from the AA. This API can be called after the user is redirected back to the FIU application from the AA, following the customer's approval or rejection of a consent request in the AA application.

#### Request Parameters

| **Parameter** | **Type** | **Mandatory vs Optional** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| webRedirectURL | string | mandatory | The web redirection URL received by the FIU containing encrypted parameters as part of ecres field. |
| resdate | string | mandatory | Date of response in ddmmyyyyhh24misss format. |
| fi | string | mandatory | Encoded Entity Id of the AA. |

#### Response Parameters

| **Parameter** | **Type** | **Mandatory vs Optional** | **Description** | **Supported Values** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| status | string | mandatory | Status of the API. | success, failure |
| ver | string | mandatory | Version of the API. |  |
| message | string | optional | Success or failure message depending on API status. |  |
| data.status | string |  | Status ‘S’ for success and ‘F’ for failure. | S, F |
| data.errorcode | string |  | Error code as per the below table. | Refer below table. |
| data.txnid | string |  | UUID received in ecreq field in the request. |  |
| data.sessionid | string |  | Value of sessionid received in the ‘ecreq’ field in the request. |  |
| data.srcref | string |  | Consent handle(s) received in the ecreq ‘srcref’ field. |  |
| data.userid | string |  | The VUA issued by AA once a user registers with an AA |  |
| data.redirect | string |  | URL of FIU application page where the user needs to be redirected to from AA. |  |

#### Error Codes

The following error codes are returned by the AA to FIU when the user is redirected back to the FIU application.

### Error Codes

| Error Code | Message | Status | Mandatory | When is this returned |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | Success | S | Y | When the user has accepted the consent |
| 1 | Consent is rejected | F | Y | When the user rejects the consent |
| 2 | Consent not available | F | Y | Consent request not found with the AA |
| 3 | Invalid request | F | Y | The redirection request has invalid data |
| 4 | User authentication failed | F | N | User is not able to authenticate self |
| 6 | Session timeout | F | N | On login page, user doesn’t act |
| 7 | Account not discovered | F | N | FIP Id is passed but the accounts were not discovered in the FIP (404) and user cancels/goes back from AA page |
| 8 | Account not discovered | F | N | FIP Id is passed but accounts not discovered due to error in FIP (non-404) and user cancels/goes back |
| 9 | Account not discovered | F | N | Multiple FIP Ids passed or none passed, and no accounts discovered in any FIP (404/other errors) |
| 10 | Account not linked | F | N | Accounts discovered; user does nothing (no linking) and session timed out |
| 11 | Account not linked | F | N | Accounts discovered; user cancels instead of linking |
| 12 | Account link OTP not attempted | F | N | Accounts discovered; user clicked link CTA but didn’t enter OTP; then cancels |
| 13 | Account link OTP not attempted | F | N | Accounts discovered; user clicked link CTA but didn’t enter OTP; session timed out |
| 14 | OTP authentication failed | F | N | All accounts link failed due to wrong OTP(s); user cancels |
| 15 | OTP authentication failed | F | N | All accounts link failed due to wrong OTP(s); session timed out |
| 16 | Account link failed | F | N | User enters valid OTP but all account link fails at FIP with some error |
| 17 | OTP failed (some accounts) | F | N | Multiple FIPs; some accounts failed due to wrong OTP; user cancels |
| 18 | OTP failed (some accounts) | F | N | Multiple FIPs; some accounts failed due to wrong OTP; session timed out |
| 19 | Account link failed (partial) | F | N | Multiple FIPs; some accounts failed; user cancels |
| 20 | Unknown error | F | N | AA is not able to send any valid error code |

request.description:
This API is used to raise request for FI to the Account Aggregator. - For Automatic FI fetch , FIUs do not need to use this API, as the FinPro system handles it. - For Periodic/Recurring fetch type, it is recommended to request for incremental data only. - Since the data flow is asynchronous, the FIU will not receive Financial Information (FI) in the response of this API. - If fiDataRange is not passed, the data is fetched as per the data range specified in the consent artefact. For periodic fetch type, incremental data is fetched. #### Request Parameters | **Parameter** | **Type** | **Mandatory vs Optional** | **Description** | **Supported Values** | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | consentId | string | mandatory | Consent ID that is provided by the AA after consent approval. | | | fiDataRangeFrom | string | optional | State date from when the FI statement is required. | ISO date format, UTC time | | fiDataRangeTo | string | optional | End date till when the FI statement is required. | ISO date format,
Should be less than or equal to current UTC timestamp. | #### Response Parameters | **Parameter** | **Type** | **Mandatory vs Optional** | **Description** | **Supported Values** | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | ver | string | mandatory | Version of the API. | | | timestamp | string | mandatory | Timestamp of the API response. | UTC time | | response | string | mandatory | API response. | | | data.consentId | string | mandatory | Consent ID for which FI Request is initiated. | | | data.sessionId | string | mandatory | Unique Session ID for the particular FI Request session. | |

This API can be used to check the status of the data request made.

| data.linkRefNumbers.linkRefNumber | string | mandatory | The linked reference number of the account. |  |

| message | string | mandatory | Success or failure message depending on the API status. |  |

request.description:
# Get All FI Data

This API endpoint allows you to download the complete financial data in JSON format associated with a specific consent or account. It can also be used to retrieve transactions for a specific date range. The API supports all Financial Information (FI) Types that are active in the Account Aggregator (AA) ecosystem, such as Deposit, Mutual Funds, Equity, and more.

**Purpose:**

- Retrieve all available financial data linked to a given consent ID.
    
- To get data for any specific account, pass LinkRefNumber along with Consent ID. \[Refer Example 2\]  
    **Note:** Data from AA is fetched at the **Consent ID** level. All accounts linked to that Consent ID will be fetched and made available for consumption.
    
- Optionally, filter transactions by a specified date range.
    

**Usage Notes:**

- Data will be returned only if it is available in FinPro.
    
- Ensure that the requested data aligns with the parameters specified in the consent.
    
- Supported FI Types are listed in the [ReBIT FI Schema](https://api.rebit.org.in/schema).
    

---

## Query Parameters (Optional)

| Parameter | Example | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| limit | limit=true | Limits the number of records returned. |
| offset | offset=true | Offsets the starting point of records. |

Example usage: `?limit=true&offset=true`

---

## Request Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Mandatory | Validation | Description | Supported Values |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| consentID | string | Yes | Consent ID that is provided by the AA after consent approval, valid GU ID. | Unique Consent ID |  |
| linkRefNumber | array | No | LinkRefNumber of the Account whose data is required. | Unique Link Ref Number of Account |  |
| transactionsStartDate | string (date) | No | ISO UTC format | Start date for required transactions (ISO UTC) |  |
| transactionsEndDate | string (date) | No | ISO UTC format | End date for required transactions (ISO UTC) |  |

**Sample Request Body:**

``` json
{
  "consentID": "<Consent_Id>",
  "transactionsStartDate": "2023-01-01T00:00:00Z", // Optional
  "transactionsEndDate": "2023-01-31T23:59:59Z"    // Optional
}

 ```

---

## Response Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Mandatory | Description | Supported Values |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ver | string | No | API version |  |
| status | string | No | Status of the response |  |
| data.linkReferenceNumber | string | Yes | Linked reference number of the account |  |
| data.maskedAccountNumber | string | Yes | Masked account number |  |
| data.fiType | string | Yes | Financial Information type | See FI Types |
| data.bank | string | Yes | Name of the bank |  |
| data.transactions | array | No | List of transactions (if requested) |  |
| data.balance | object | No | Account balance details |  |
| data.profile | object | No | Account profile information |  |
| data.holder | object | No | Account holder details |  |
| data.summary | object | No | Account summary |  |
| timestamp | string | optional | The timestamp of the transaction. |  |

**Supported FI Types:**

- DEPOSIT, TERM_DEPOSIT, TERM-DEPOSIT, RECURRING_DEPOSIT, SIP, CP, GOVT_SECURITIES, EQUITIES, BONDS, DEBENTURES, MUTUAL_FUNDS, ETF, IDR, CIS, AIF, INSURANCE_POLICIES, NPS, INVIT, REIT, GSTR1_3B, LIFE_INSURANCE, GENERAL_INSURANCE, OTHER
    

---

## Error Response Format

When an error occurs, the API returns a JSON object with the following structure:

| Sr. No. | Field | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `ver` | String (Optional) |
| 2 | `timestamp` | String (Optional) |
| 3 | `errorCode` | String (Optional) |
| 4 | `errorMsg` | String (Optional) |
| 5 | `status` | String (Optional) |

## Error Code Catalogue

| # | Status | Error Code | Error Message | Payload (Request Body) | Tested (Y/N) | Violated Rule |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | null | InvalidRequest | transactionsStartDate must be a valid ISO date | `{"consentID": "test123", "transactionsStartDate": "2024-13-01"}` | Y | Invalid ISO date format |
| 2 |  | InvalidRequest | \[ consentID must be a string \] | `{"consentID": null}` | Y | consentID cannot be null; must be a valid string value |
| 3 | null | InvalidRequest | transactionsEndDate must be a valid ISO date | `{"consentID": "test123", "transactionsEndDate": "01-01-2024"}` | Y | Non-ISO date format |
| 4 | FP0055 | InvalidPayload | Either consentId or accountID should be passed and both consentID and accountID should not be passed in payload | `{}` | Y | No consentID provided |
| 5 | FP0034 | InvalidConsentId | Consent ID does not exist. | `{"consentID": "nonexistent-consent-id-12345"}` | Y | ConsentID not found in database |
| 6 | FP0058 | InvalidRequest | Consent ID is Revoked with consent type as VIEW. | Valid consent with VIEW mode and REVOKED status | Setup Required | Cannot view revoked VIEW-type consent |
| 7 | FP0060 | NoDataAvailable | Data is not available for the given consent | Valid consent without fetched data | Setup Required | No FI data has been fetched |
| 8 | FP0061 | DataIsDeleted | Data is deleted for this consent | Valid consent with expired data | Setup Required | FI data expired and deleted |
| 9 | FP0063 | NoDataFound | Data is not available | Valid consent without artefact accounts | Setup Required | No linked accounts found |
| 10 | FP0070 | InternalError | Internal Server Error : accountFIDataList | N/A | Setup Required | Unexpected error in controller logic |
| 11 |  | InvalidRequest | \[ consentID value can have only A to Z, a to z, 0 to 9, _ , - and . characters \] | {"consentID": "06e94cb9#c5daOf0-b9a6-07edb3a32d4d"} | Y | ConsentID payload validation failed |

## Example Success Response

``` json
{
  "ver": "1.0",
  "status": "success",
  "data": {
    "linkReferenceNumber": "1234567890",
    "maskedAccountNumber": "XXXXXX1234",
    "fiType": "DEPOSIT",
    "bank": "Sample Bank",
    "transactions": [ ... ],
    "balance": { ... },
    "profile": { ... },
    "holder": { ... },
    "summary": { ... }
  }
}

 ```

## Example Error Response

``` json
{
  "ver": "1.0",
  "status": "failure",
  "error": {
    "code": "ERR_CONSENT_NOT_FOUND",
    "message": "Consent ID not found or expired."
  }
}

 ```

---

For more details on FI Types and schema, refer to the [ReBIT FI Schema](https://api.rebit.org.in/schema).

request.description:
This API can be used to download the complete financial data in PDF associated with the consent/account. It can also be used to get transactions for a specific date range.

Note:

- Data will be returned only if it is available in FinPro.
    
- Ensure requested data is fetched as per consent parameters.
    

#### Request Parameters

| **Parameter** | **Type** | **Mandatory vs Optional** | **Description** | **Supported Values** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| consentId | string | mandatory | Unique Consent ID |  |
| linkReferenceNumber | string | optional | List of linkReferenceNumber for which data is required. If not passed, data for all the accounts will be returned. |  |
| transactionsStartDate | string($date-time) | optional | Start date from which transactions are required. | ISO date format, UTC time |
| transactionsEndDate | string($date-time) | optional | End date till which transactions are required. | ISO date format, UTC time |

#### Response Parameters

| **Parameter** | **Type** | **Mandatory vs Optional** | **Description** | **Supported Values** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ver | string | mandatory | The version of the API. |  |
| status | string | mandatory | Status of the response. | success, failure |
| data.linkReferenceNumber | string | mandatory | Linked reference number of the account. |  |
| data.maskedAccountNumber | string | mandatory | Masked account number. |  |
| data.fiType | string | mandatory | Financial Information type. | DEPOSIT, TERM_DEPOSIT, TERM-DEPOSIT, RECURRING_DEPOSIT, SIP, CP, GOVT_SECURITIES, EQUITIES, BONDS, DEBENTURES, MUTUAL_FUNDS, ETF, IDR, CIS, AIF, INSURANCE_POLICIES, NPS, INVIT, REIT, GSTR1_3B, LIFE_INSURANCE, GENERAL_INSURANCE, OTHER |
| data.bank | string | mandatory | Name of the bank. |  |
| data.Profile.Holders.type | string | mandatory | Type of account holders. | SINGLE, JOINT |
| data.Profile.Holders.Holder.name | string | mandatory | Name of the account holder. |  |
| data.Profile.Holders.Holder.dob | string | mandatory | Date of birth of the account holder. |  |
| data.Profile.Holders.Holder.mobile | string | mandatory | Mobile number of the account holder. |  |
| data.Profile.Holders.Holder.nominee | string | mandatory | Nominee status | Registered, Not-Registered |
| data.Profile.Holders.Holder.landline | string | mandatory | Landline number of the account holder. |  |
| data.Profile.Holders.Holder.address | string | mandatory | Address of the account holder. |  |
| data.Profile.Holders.Holder.email | string | mandatory | Email address of the account holder. |  |
| data.Profile.Holders.Holder.pan | string | mandatory | PAN number of the account holder. |  |
| data.Profile.Holders.Holder.ckycCompliance | string | mandatory | CKYC compliance status. | YES, NO, NO_DATA_AVAILABLE |
| data.Summary.currentBalance | string | mandatory | Current balance of the account. |  |
| data.Summary.currency | string | mandatory | Currency of the account balance. |  |
| data.Summary.exchgeRate | string | mandatory | Exchange rate. |  |
| data.Summary.balanceDateTime | string | mandatory | Date and time of the balance. |  |
| data.Summary.type | string | mandatory | Type of account. | SAVINGS, CURRENT |
| data.Summary.branch | string | mandatory | Branch of the bank. |  |
| data.Summary.facility | string | mandatory | Facility of the account, e.g., OD. |  |
| data.Summary.ifscCode | string | mandatory | IFSC code of the bank branch. |  |
| data.Summary.micrCode | string | mandatory | MICR code of the bank branch. |  |
| data.Summary.openingDate | string | mandatory | Opening date of the account. |  |
| data.Summary.currentODLimit | string | mandatory | Current overdraft limit. |  |
| data.Summary.drawingLimit | string | mandatory | Drawing limit of the account. |  |
| data.Summary.status | string | mandatory | Status of the account, e.g., ACTIVE. |  |
| data.Summary.Pending.amount | string | mandatory | Pending amount. |  |
| data.Summary.Pending.transactionType | string | mandatory | Type of pending transaction, e.g., DEBIT. |  |
| data.Transactions.startDate | string | mandatory | Start date of the transaction period. |  |
| data.Transactions.endDate | string | mandatory | End date of the transaction period. |  |
| data.Transactions.Transaction.type | string | mandatory | Type of transaction. | CREDIT, DEBIT |
| data.Transactions.Transaction.mode | string | mandatory | Mode of transaction. | CASH,UPI,IMPS,NEFT,RTGS,CARD,ATM,CHEQUE,DEMAND_DRAFT,AUTO_DEBIT,INTEREST_CREDIT, NACH, ECS, REMITTANCE, OTHERS |
| data.Transactions.Transaction.amount | string | mandatory | Amount of the transaction. |  |
| data.Transactions.Transaction.currentBalance | string | mandatory | Current balance after the transaction. |  |
| data.Transactions.Transaction.transactionTimestamp | string | mandatory | Timestamp of the transaction. |  |
| data.Transactions.Transaction.valueDate | string | mandatory | Value date of the transaction. |  |
| data.Transactions.Transaction.txnId | string | mandatory | Transaction ID. |  |
| data.Transactions.Transaction.narration | string | mandatory | Description of the transaction. |  |
| data.Transactions.Transaction.reference | string | mandatory | Transaction reference number, e.g., Cheque number. |  |

request.description:
# Get FI Data

This API endpoint retrieves the transaction details for a specific account, as authorized by a user's consent. The response is provided in JSON format and includes comprehensive transaction and account information.

## Purpose

Use this API to fetch the transactions of a particular account linked to a valid consent. It is suitable for applications such as spend analysis, account aggregation, and financial insights, where periodic transaction data retrieval is required.

## Usage Notes

- Ensure that the data requested aligns with the parameters specified in the user's consent.
    
- Only accounts associated with the provided consentId and linkReferenceNumber will be processed.
    
- The API is designed to support periodic polling for transaction updates.
    

## Supported Account Types

- Current Account
    
- Savings Account
    
- Fixed Deposit
    
- Recurring Deposit
    

## Query Parameters (Optional)

| Parameter | Example | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| limit | limit=true | Limits the number of transactions returned. |
| offset | offset=true | Specifies the starting point for returned results. |

Example usage: `?limit=true&offset=true`

## Request Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Mandatory | Validation | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| consentId | string | Yes | Consent ID that is provided by the AA after consent approval, valid GU ID. | Unique Consent ID. |
| linkReferenceNumber | string | Yes | Valid and Unique Link Reference Number for the account present in the database. | Unique Link Reference Number for the account. |

**Sample Request Body:**

``` json
{
  "linkReferenceNumber": "<LinkRefNumber>",
  "consentID": "<Consent_Id>"
}

 ```

## Response Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Mandatory | Description | Supported Values |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| status | string | No | Status of the response. |  |
| ver | string | No | Version of the API. |  |
| data.linkReferenceNumber | string | Yes | Link reference number of the account. |  |
| data.maskedAccountNumber | string | Yes | Masked account number. |  |
| data.balance | string | Yes | Account balance. |  |
| data.fipName | string | Yes | FIP (Financial Institution Provider) name. |  |
| data.fipId | string | Yes | FIP ID. |  |
| data.fiType | string | Yes | Financial Information type. | DEPOSIT, TERM_DEPOSIT, RECURRING_DEPOSIT |
| data.fiData.transactionTimestamp | string | Yes | Timestamp of the transaction. |  |
| data.fiData.txnId | string | Yes | Transaction ID. |  |
| data.fiData.type | string | Yes | Type of transaction. | CREDIT, DEBIT |
| data.fiData.amount | string | Yes | Transaction amount. |  |
| timestamp | string | optional | The timestamp of the transaction. |  |

#### Error Response Format

When an error occurs, the API returns a JSON object with the following structure:

| Sr. No. | Field | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `ver` | String (Optional) |
| 2 | `timestamp` | String (Optional) |
| 3 | `errorCode` | String (Optional) |
| 4 | `errorMsg` | String (Optional) |
| 5 | `status` | String (Optional) |

**Sample Success Response:**

``` json
{
  "status": "success",
  "ver": "1.0",
  "data": {
    "linkReferenceNumber": "1234567890",
    "maskedAccountNumber": "XXXXXX1234",
    "balance": "10000.00",
    "fipName": "Sample Bank",
    "fipId": "SBIN0001234",
    "fiType": "DEPOSIT",
    "fiData": [
      {
        "transactionTimestamp": "2024-06-01T10:00:00Z",
        "txnId": "TXN123456",
        "type": "CREDIT",
        "amount": "5000.00"
      },
      {
        "transactionTimestamp": "2024-06-02T12:00:00Z",
        "txnId": "TXN123457",
        "type": "DEBIT",
        "amount": "2000.00"
      }
    ]
  }
}

 ```

## Error Handling

If the request fails, the response will indicate the failure status and may include an error message.

**Sample Error Response:**

``` json
{
  "status": "failure",
  "ver": "1.0",
  "message": "Invalid consent ID or link reference number."
}

 ```

---

For more details, refer to the [Moneyone FinPro](https://collection/12076903-93f0aafc-6712-471a-b311-b7c61403379a) collection documentation.

request.description:
This API provides the Transactions of a particular account in associated with the consent, in XML.

Note :

- Ensure requested data is fetched as per consent parameters
    
- For a Spend Analysis feature, this API can be used to just get only the transactions periodically.
    

#### Request Parameters

| **Parameter** | Type | Mandatory vs Optional | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| consentId | string | mandatory | Unique Consent ID. |
| linkReferenceNumber | string | mandatory | Uniqure Link Refence Number of a specific account. |

#### Response Parameters

| **Parameter** | **Type** | **Mandatory vs Optional** | **Description** | **Supported Values** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| status | string | mandatory | Status of the response. | success, failure |
| ver | string | mandatory | Version of the API. |  |
| data.linkReferenceNumber | string | mandatory | Link reference number of the account. |  |
| data.maskedAccountNumber | string | mandatory | Masked account number. |  |
| data.balance | string | mandatory | Account Balance. |  |
| data.fipName | string | mandatory | FIP Name. |  |
| data.fipId | string | mandatory | FIP Id. |  |
| data.fiType | string | mandatory | Financial Information type. | DEPOSIT, TERM_DEPOSIT, TERM-DEPOSIT, RECURRING_DEPOSIT |
| data.fiData.transactionTimestamp | string | mandatory | Timestamp of the transaction. |  |
| data.fiData.txnId | string | mandatory | Transaction Id. |  |
| data.fiData.type | string | mandatory | Type of transaction. | CREDIT, DEBIT |
| data.fiData.amount | string | mandatory | Transaction Amount. |  |
| data.fiData.balance | string | mandatory | Balance after the transaction. |  |
| data.fiData.mode | string | mandatory | Transaction mode. | CASH, UPI, IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, CARD, ATM, CHEQUE, DEMAND_DRAFT, AUTO_DEBIT, INTEREST_CREDIT, NACH, ECS, REMITTANCE,OTHERS |
| data.fiData.narration | string | mandatory | Description of the transaction. |  |
| data.fiData.reference | string | mandatory | Transaction reference number e.g. Cheque number. |  |
| data.fiData.valueDate | string | mandatory | Effective date of transaction. |  |

# Get FI Balance

## Purpose

This API retrieves the account balance for one or more accounts associated with a specific consent. It is designed to support Personal Finance Management (PFM) features by providing the latest balances for all eligible accounts in a single response.

## Usage Notes

- Supported account types:
    
    - Current Account
        
    - Savings Account
        
    - Fixed Deposit
        
    - Recurring Deposit
        
- If `linkReferenceNumber` is not provided, the API returns balances for all accounts linked to the given consent.
    
- Use this endpoint to display consolidated balances for users in PFM dashboards or account summary views.
    

## Request

- **Method:** POST
    
- **URL:** `{{Base_URL}}/getfibalance`
    
- **Headers:**
    
    - `Content-Type: application/json`
        
    - `client_id: {{Client_Id}}`
        
    - `client_secret: {{Client_Secret}}`
        
    - `organisationId: {{Organisation_Id}}`
        
    - `appIdentifier: {{App_Identifier}}`
        
- **Body (raw, JSON):**
    
    ``` json
              {
                "linkReferenceNumber": "{{LinkRefNumber}}",
                "consentID": "{{Consent_Id}}"
              }
    
     ```
    

### Request Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Mandatory | Validation | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| consentID | string | Yes | Consent ID that is provided by the AA after consent approval, valid GU ID. | Unique Consent ID for which account balances are requested. |
| linkReferenceNumber | string | Yes\* | Valid linkReferenceNumber should be provided that has been previously by AA corresponding to the respective consent ID. | List of linkReferenceNumbers for which data is required. If omitted, returns all accounts. |

\*If not provided, balances for all accounts under the consent will be returned.

## Response

- **Content-Type:** application/json
    

### Response Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Mandatory | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| status | string | No |  |
| ver | string | No | API version number. |
| data.fiType | string | Yes | Financial Information type. E.g., `DEPOSIT`, `TERM_DEPOSIT`, etc. |
| data.fipId | string | Yes | FIP (Financial Information Provider) ID. |
| data.fipName | string | Yes | Name of the FIP. |
| data.balance | string | Yes | Account balance. |
| data.linkReferenceNumber | string | Yes | Linked reference number of the account. |
| data.maskedAccountNumber | string | Yes | Masked account number. |
| timestamp | string | optional | The timestamp of the transaction. |

#### Error Response Format

When an error occurs, the API returns a JSON object with the following structure:

| Sr. No. | Field | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `ver` | String (Optional) |
| 2 | `timestamp` | String (Optional) |
| 3 | `errorCode` | String (Optional) |
| 4 | `errorMsg` | String (Optional) |
| 5 | `status` | String (Optional) |

#### Error Code Catalogue

| # | Error Code | Error Message | Payload Example | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | InvalidRequest | \[linkReferenceNumber is required\] \[consentID is required\] | `{}` | Both mandatory fields missing |
| 2 | InvalidRequest | \[consentID is required\] | `{ "linkReferenceNumber": "7f8227f1-697f-40d3-a4af-0508f5d0a1dd" }` | consentID is mandatory field |
| 3 | InvalidRequest | \[linkReferenceNumber is required\] | `{ "consentID": "abc123" }` | linkReferenceNumber is mandatory |

## Example Request

``` json
{
  "linkReferenceNumber": "7f8227f1-697f-40d3-a4af-0508f5d0a1dd",
  "consentID": "abc123"
}

 ```

## Example Response

``` json
{
  "status": "success",
  "ver": "1.0",
  "data": [
    {
      "fiType": "DEPOSIT",
      "fipId": "FIP001",
      "fipName": "Sample Bank",
      "balance": "10000.00",
      "linkReferenceNumber": "7f8227f1-697f-40d3-a4af-0508f5d0a1dd",
      "maskedAccountNumber": "XXXXXX1234"
    }
  ]
}

 ```

---

For further details, refer to the [Moneyone FinPro](https://collection/12076903-93f0aafc-6712-471a-b311-b7c61403379a) collection documentation.

request.description:
This API provides the list of Products (Consent Templates) and the corresponding consent parameters creating by the FIU in the admin portal.

This API can be used for product selection before initiating a consent.

#### Request Parameter

| **Parameter** | **Type** | **Mandatory vs Optional** | **Validation** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| productId | string | optional | Alphanumeric identifiers only | Consent template ID created in the admin portal. |

#### Response Parameters

| **Parameter** | **Type** | **Description** | **Supported Values** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ver | string | Version of the API. |  |
| status | string | Status of the response. | success, failure |
| data.productName | string | Consent Template Name. |  |
| data.productCode | string | Consent Template Code. |  |
| data.productDescription | string | Consent Template Description. |  |
| data.consentFrom | string($date-time) | Start date of the consent. |  |
| data.consentTo | string($date-time) | End date of the consent. The difference between the start and end date is the consent validity. |  |
| data.consentMode | string | Mode of the consent. | VIEW, STORE |
| data.fetchType | string | Data fetch type. | ONETIME, PERIODIC |
| data.fiTypes | string | The types of Financial Information (FI) Schemas associated. | DEPOSIT, TERM_DEPOSIT, TERM-DEPOSIT, RECURRING_DEPOSIT, SIP, CP, GOVT_SECURITIES, EQUITIES, BONDS, DEBENTURES, MUTUAL_FUNDS, ETF, IDR, CIS, AIF, INSURANCE_POLICIES, NPS, INVIT, REIT, GSTR1_3B, LIFE_INSURANCE, GENERAL_INSURANCE, OTHER |
| data.consentTypes | string | The sections of the FI required. | PROFILE, SUMMARY, TRANSACTIONS |
| data.dataRangeFrom | string($date-time) | Start date of the FI required. |  |
| data.dataRangeTo | string($date-time) | End date of the FI required. The difference between the start and end date is the data range. |  |
| data.dataLifeUnit | string | Unit of data life. | DAY, MONTH, YEAR, INF |
| data.dataLifeValue | string | Value of data life. |  |
| data.frequencyUnit | string | Unit of data fetch frequency. | DAY, MONTH, YEAR, INF |
| data.frequencyValue | string | Value of data fetch frequency. |  |
| data.fiFetch | string | Method of data fetch. | MANUAL, AUTOMATIC, AUTO MANUAL |
| data.createdAt | string($date-time) | Timestamp of consent template creation. |  |
